busy_with_quest.text: You've already got an active contract running on your neural grid. Finish what you started before coming to me for more work.

choices.text: "Right. I'll finish my current contract first."

start.text: You got nerve walking right into our turf on foot. What's your business here?

choices.text: "Looking for work. Got anything that needs doing?"

quest_pickup.text: As a matter of fact, I do. Need an encrypted data-chip delivered to a contact waiting next to a motorcycle outside the south quadrant block. You deliver it clean, there's 500 Credits in it for you.

choices.text: "I'll take the job. Hand over the data-chip."

quest_accepted.text: Good. I've uploaded the delivery coordinates to your Tactical Overmap [M]. Don't keep Banquo's operative waiting.

turf_info.text: This parking lot belongs to the Neon Syndicate. We run the asphalt in this block. You drive clean, we don't have a problem.

no_trouble.text: Keep it that way. My crew is watching every step you take.

threaten.text: Big words for someone standing surrounded. Don't test me, stranger.
